name: zxing
description_en: ZXing ("Zebra Crossing") barcode scanning library for Java, Android
readme_excerpt: Project in Maintenance Mode Only; Barcode Scanner not available The project is in maintenance mode, meaning, changes are driven by contributed patches. Only bug fixes and minor enhancements will be considered. The Barcode Scanner app can no longer be published, so it's unlikely any changes will be accepted for it.
